source.method: Extracted from PDF embedded exact RESULTS.json; Chinese display labels checked against report main tables. No model execution.

input_roles.target_text: Ask her to bring these things with her from the store.
input_roles.input_format: 24 kHz mono FLOAT, then native model frontend

design.intervention: One functional module continuous output at a time; independent normalized Gaussian direction; active mask only; model weights and integer token IDs unchanged.
design.controls: Two same-seed CLEAN repeats and one ZERO_CONTROL for each model and seed; failed control blocks corresponding probes.

D.meaning_en: Voice embedding movement; larger does not mean identity failure.
D.meaning_zh: 声纹移动量；越大不代表越不像目标。

A.meaning_en: Target-similarity drop; positive = farther, negative = closer.
A.meaning_zh: 对目标相似度下降；正值更远，负值反而更接近。

metrics.summary_values: Arithmetic means over eligible cells. Min/max are observed ranges, not confidence intervals.
metrics.automatic_eligibility_field_note: The source field identity_interpretable is an automatic engineering/content/control eligibility flag, not a human identity judgment.

automated_gate.meaning: Engineering/content qualification only; does not certify naturalness, no repetitions, human quality or human identity.

limitations_en: One speaker and one target phrase, two random directions, one alpha; descriptive local sensitivity only.
Equal relative activation norm does not equal perceptual dose or cumulative dose. Compare only within the same model and exact panel; do not turn effects into additive contribution percentages.
D measures change, not degradation; A is encoder-dependent and may be negative. No human listening or MOS evaluation was performed.
Internal interventions are mechanism probes, not waveform-only protection. A sensitive internal boundary need not be reachable from a perceptually acceptable reference WAV.
Generated reconstruction-layer changes may include distortion even when ASR passes.
Missing and blocked results remain unknown rather than zero. Generated audio was deleted after scoring and cannot be newly listened to from this report.

models.name: F5-TTS
models.takeaway_zh: 在反复生成部分，联合DiT输入比同样32次调用的主干输出更敏感；两种算法的平均目标相似度都下降。

sites.name_zh: 实际参考 Mel 条件

models.takeaway_en: The joint DiT input was more sensitive than the DiT backbone output within the repeated-boundary group; both were injected 32 times.
models.caution_en: Single reference/text boundaries and repeated DiT boundaries are different intervention groups.

models.name: Qwen3-TTS
models.takeaway_zh: 身份向量、参考语音码和文本投影都能移动声纹；不少扰动反而更接近目标人，不能把移动量直接当身份损失。
models.takeaway_en: Speaker, reference codec and text conditions all moved the output embedding. Yet 28 of 48 probes made it closer to the target under both encoders.
models.caution_en: Talker and Subtalker receive different numbers of injections; movement is not identity loss.

models.name: OpenVoice
models.takeaway_zh: 内容潜变量也能改变声纹；24/48个扰动的变化方向在两种算法间相反。
models.takeaway_en: The source posterior latent also moved the output embedding; output-embedding changes were not confined to the target timbre vector.
models.caution_en: The two encoders disagreed on the direction of target-similarity change in 24 of 48 probes.

limitations_zh: 一名目标说话人、一句目标文本、两个随机方向、一个扰动强度，只能描述局部敏感度。
相同相对激活范数不等于相同感知剂量或累计剂量，只能在同模型和同精确分组内描述；不能换算为相加贡献百分比。
D测变化而非退化；A依赖评价编码器，可为负；本轮没有人耳或MOS评价。
内部边界干预是机制探针，不是仅修改WAV的保护成功；敏感边界未必可由人耳正常的参考WAV到达。
生成Mel与波形重建的改变可能包含失真，即使ASR通过也不能排除。
缺失/阻断保留未知；新生成音频评分后已删除，无法从此报告再进行听评。
visualization_note: Dots show executed units; squares and ranges use automatically eligible units. An open red diamond is an executed unit that failed the automatic gate. Ranges are observed minima/maxima, not confidence intervals. Axes rescale by model; no cross-group contribution ranking.
